name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri Volkov's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. A graduate of the Bauman Moscow State Technical University with a degree in aerospace engineering, he found himself drawn to the precision and problem-solving inherent in racing. He started volunteering at local karting events, quickly impressing teams with his ability to diagnose and resolve mechanical issues. This led to a role with a small Formula Russia team, where he honed his skills in data analysis and vehicle dynamics.

Over the years, Dimitri has developed a reputation as a meticulous and methodical engineer. He prioritizes clear communication and collaborative problem-solving, fostering a strong sense of teamwork within his crews. While perhaps not the most outwardly innovative engineer, Dimitri excels at refining existing setups and extracting maximum performance from available resources. His dedication to continuous improvement and unwavering focus on detail have made him a valuable asset to any team.

At CRG Racing Team, Dimitri is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to simplify complex technical issues for the driver. He believes in building a strong, trusting relationship with the driver, ensuring that they feel confident and informed throughout the race weekend. He's also a firm believer in the importance of thorough pre-race preparation, often spending hours meticulously reviewing data and simulating different scenarios.

physical.description: Dimitri is a man of average height with a sturdy build, betraying his years of hands-on work.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Prefers to drink strong black tea throughout the day, refusing any sugar or milk.
